title: Capture Tactus platform improvements needed by Kanbus
description:
Track improvements that belong in Tactus itself, not as Kanbus-specific workarounds. Kanbus should be a demanding production consumer of Tactus procedures and tools.

Acceptance:
- Missing Tactus capabilities are documented as explicit tasks.
- Kanbus integration avoids baking in temporary assumptions where Tactus should provide a stable primitive.
- Each Tactus-facing gap has a concrete owner/repo decision before implementation.
